The '''Geonosian swamp flu''' was a [[Flu/Legends|flu]] originating from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. [[Ferdoin]] tried to fake the flu symptoms while deserting from the [[Republic Army]].
